name: PERSONAL_INFORMATION
description: General personal information such as address history and residency questions used for jurisdiction, venue, and required disclosures.

name: OPPOSING_PARTY_INFORMATION
description: Information about the opposing party in the matter.

name: LEGAL_DETAILS
description: Legal details relevant to the matter.

name: FAMILY_BACKGROUND
description: Family background information relevant to the matter.

name: CUSTODY_ARRANGEMENTS
description: Custody arrangement details for children involved in the matter.

name: ATTORNEY_ONLY
description: Attorney-only or internal operational fields that support drafting strategy, court configuration, and case management (not typically collected directly from clients).

name: CLIENT
description: Client-facing intake information about the person seeking services, including identity, contact details, and background used across generated documents and workflows.

name: OPPOSING_PARTY
description: Information about the other party in the matter (e.g., spouse or co-parent), used to complete pleadings, disclosures, and service/case details where required.

name: MARRIAGE
description: Details about the marriage and separation timeline, agreements, and related facts that drive divorce eligibility, pleading content, and requested relief.

name: CHILDREN
description: Information about children involved in the matter, including identities, residences, and custody/support context used across filings and required disclosures.

name: ASSETS
description: Information about property, vehicles, benefits, and other assets relevant to equitable division and required financial disclosures.

name: CASE_DETAILS
description: Case-level procedural and factual details (service, orders, hearings, related cases, safety concerns) used to prepare filings and manage workflow requirements.

name: HOUSEHOLD
description: Household composition and contributions, used for financial disclosures, budgeting, and support-related calculations where applicable.

name: TAXES
description: Tax filing and withholding information used for financial disclosures and income/expense analysis where applicable.

name: INCOME
description: Income sources and amounts (employment, self-employment, benefits, investments), used for disclosures and support-related analyses.

name: EXPENSES
description: Recurring household and personal expenses used for financial disclosures, budgeting, and support-related analyses.

name: JOINT_ASSETS
description: Details about assets owned jointly by the parties, used for property division and related financial disclosures.

name: JOINT_DEBTS
description: Details about debts owed jointly by the parties, used for financial disclosures and allocation in the case.

name: PERSONAL_ASSETS
description: Details about assets considered separate/personal to one party, used in property characterization and financial disclosures.

name: PERSONAL_DEBTS
description: Details about debts considered separate/personal to one party, used in liability characterization and financial disclosures.

name: DEBTS
description: Information about liabilities and debts relevant to financial disclosures and division between the parties.

name: PETITIONER
